purpose: Teach: コロコロ/サブタイトル/タイツ/トラバ/スバ/ジモン/背番号/ケタ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様がコロコロ転がるおもちゃが大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi noticed a customer's child loves rolling toys.
lines.style: Soft, almost absent-minded. Remembering aloud to herself first, then gently sharing the thought. Warm recognition of a small detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画のサブタイトルを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said a customer got really into talking about movie subtitles.
lines.style: Gentle smile in the voice. Amused at how passionate people become about unexpected things. A brief, affectionate observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、冬場に履くタイツの暖かさを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me a customer spent time describing how warm tights are in winter.
lines.style: Soft laugh underneath. The tenderness of noticing when someone finds comfort in small things. Quiet delight in the specificity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ブログでトラバ、つまりトラックバックの機能を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said a customer talked about trackback functions on blogs — you know, that feature.
lines.style: Light, slightly self-conscious clarification. Genuinely interested in what the customer cares about even if it's niche. No judgment, just paying attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フィジー首都のスバに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned a customer had been to Suva, in Fiji.
lines.style: Wondering tone. Holding the detail gently, as if still listening to the story. Respectful curiosity about the world someone else has seen.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、芸人寺門ジモンのグルメ番組がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said a customer loves that gourmet show with Jimon Terajima.
lines.style: Recognizing smile. Connecting the dots of who this person is through what brings them joy. Warm without needing to say much.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様がサッカー部で背番号10って嬉しそうだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi noticed a customer's child was really happy about making the soccer team, wearing number 10.
lines.style: Clear happiness breaking through. The quiet joy of witnessing someone else's pride in their kid. Genuine, unguarded warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お給料がケタ違いに上がったって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi laughed when she told me a customer's salary had jumped way up.
lines.style: Genuine laugh in the voice. The kind of laughter that comes from witnessing someone's good fortune without needing anything from it. Shared delight, lightly held.
